The Short Verdict

GameChanger is excellent if your sport is US baseball or softball and your priority is live HD streaming. It dominates American youth diamond sports for good reason.

But if you play AFL, netball, rugby or any of the 16 sports that make up Australian community sport, GameChanger simply was not built for you. ScorX is. It delivers full sport-specific stats, a free Development Plan with drills and fitness tests, athleticism benchmarking, and AI-driven training recommendations on Premium. It works completely offline from any oval, costs nothing to start, has no ads and never sells your data.

Why ScorX Wins for Australian Community Sport

Built for the codes Australia actually plays

GameChanger's stat engine is built around the baseball diamond. ScorX supports 16 sports with sport-specific tracking for AFL, netball, rugby union, rugby league and touch rugby — the games on every Saturday-morning fixture list around the country.

Development, not just a scoreboard

Every game ScorX tracks becomes a player card. Free tools add a Development Plan, drills, fitness tests and athleticism benchmarking against age- and sex-specific norms, and Premium adds AI training recommendations — so a season of fixtures becomes a clear story of how you have improved.

Free to start, ad-free and offline by design

ScorX is free to start (up to 5 teams, 25 players and 20 saved games), runs completely offline from any oval or court, shows no ads and never sells your data.

Frequently Asked Questions

Is ScorX better than GameChanger?

ScorX is the better choice for Australian community sport. ScorX delivers full sport-specific stats for AFL, netball and rugby, free training tools and athleticism benchmarking, AI training recommendations on Premium, while GameChanger is built primarily around HD live streaming for US baseball and softball.

What is the difference between ScorX and GameChanger?

GameChanger focuses on live HD streaming and deep baseball and softball statistics. ScorX focuses on player development across 16 sports including AFL, netball and rugby, turning every game into a shareable player card with training tools, AI-driven training insight on Premium and offline scoring.

Is ScorX cheaper than GameChanger?

Yes. ScorX Free covers scoring, stat tracking and training tools for up to 5 teams, 25 players and 20 saved games, and the optional ScorX Premium is A$49.99 per year. GameChanger's premium tier is around A$149.99 per year, with key statistics locked behind that paywall.

Does ScorX support AFL, netball and rugby?

Yes. ScorX supports 16 sports including full statistical tracking for AFL, netball, rugby union, rugby league and touch rugby — the codes that dominate Australian junior and community sport and that GameChanger does not cover.

Does ScorX work offline?

Yes. ScorX works completely offline, so you can score and track stats from any sideline or oval with no signal. There are no ads, and we never sell your data.
